mechanism_draft.economic_explanation: Signal-Portfolio Translation Failure 3요인 가설: (1) Top-20 long-only concentration trap — signal ranking quality는 cross-sectional 전체 universe 기반이나 actual portfolio는 top 20 집중 → sector bias + concentration risk 극단화 + universe outlier 편중. (2) Defense family specific vulnerability — distress/Calmar signals ranking quality 있으나 실제 portfolio 편입 시 부실기업 cluster or high-risk outlier 유도 + publication decay (BAB, Calmar 2020년대 ETF 유입으로 약화). (3) KR market structural factors — 재벌 cluster 과다, sector HHI 1800-2200. 교훈: strong signal ≠ successful portfolio. IC-to-return transmission failure가 structural pattern 가능성. Long-short structure or multi-sleeve sub-sleeve 구조로 회피 가능.
